description.value:
Category: Seen Gods

Primarily Practiced in: Zahnheim, Weissel

Espirian Domains: The Heavens (Elysium, Baythal)

Denau is the successor to Passhow, former God of the Harvest who perished during the Zahnheimen Kingdoms War’s end; the one who brings the autumn fall, and the birth of all life and nature in its purest, primal form. Life energy is the prime element associated with him, for in Denau the cycle of life is perpetuated; All things grow, mature, age and wither; all living beings must obtain their sustenance from one source to the next. Denau is also tied to the change of the seasons and is most often celebrated during the times of spring and autumn. Many pastoral folks worship him, as well as druids and harvest bringers, responsible for bringing his graces to create the idealized conditions for nature to grow its bounty. In his depictions, Denau looks much like Passhow did; a loupain of golden fur; bent, long ears with a hearty and hale gait.

In the wake of the Scourge’s End, Denau’s earliest followers came from a region of Zahnheim where Kleoscourge and fiends have used illusion and trickery to fool the populace; to which case, Denau’s domains are affiliated with discerning truth and excising illusions and fiends where they lay.

Title God of the Harvest

Edicts Respect nature, provide for those in need, hold feasts

Anathema Use illusions to trick and deceive the commonfolk, borrow fiendish power

Areas of Concern Truth, Harvests, Animal Husbandry

Religious Symbol Arrows that bear arrowheads of wheat

Sacred Animal Retriever dog

Sacred Colors gold and brown
